name: ui-preview-gate
description: Approval gate for UI changes: inspect the real screen, get approval on a side-by-side before/after image before coding, then verify the result against it.

interface.shortDescription: Preview UI changes as before/after images, then verify the result
interface.longDescription: Before an agent changes a screen, it captures the real current screen, shows a side-by-side before/after image with red and green boxes, and waits for approval. After implementing, it captures the result and compares it with the approved preview.
defaultPrompt: Add a coupon field to the checkout screen.
Show me how this settings tab would look with a new toggle.
Check that the shipped screen matches the approved preview.
